TestSchemaChanges::test_schema_and_data_.description: 2-node (2 racks) cluster started on last release (upgrade_matrix_from_last_release_version = release:2026.1); for each version in the upgrade path, node1 is upgraded, then in both directions (upgraded->old, old->upgraded) runs CREATE KEYSPACE/TABLE + 200 inserts at CL=ALL, ALTER TABLE ADD column + updates, DROP TABLE, DROP KEYSPACE, each verified on the other-version node (row count, full scan, per-key reads at CL=ALL, InvalidRequest after drops). Then node2 is upgraded and the raft topology upgrade procedure (schema-on-raft wait, enable_raft_topology, SL v2 wait) is run if not already enabled. Guards schema/data forward/backward compatibility in a mixed-version cluster (GROUP0_SCHEMA_VERSIONING); it caught SCYLLADB-2062 (segfault in create_tables_from_tables_partition on old node due to new CDC option 'enable_requested').
